title: Samsung Notification
blurb: Five quick tones inside two seconds, rising then settling like a doorbell that learned some manners. This is the Android answer to Apple's tri-tone, doing the identical job in a completely different accent. Where the iPhone alert is bright and metallic, this one sits far lower and rounder, closer to a marimba than a bell. Samsung owners stop consciously hearing it within a week of unboxing the phone, then cannot unhear it anywhere else for years. Useful to anyone cutting a scene where a handset needs to go off without an Apple logo entering the frame.
origin: The default notification alert shipped on Samsung Galaxy handsets.
